Reading configuration, wiring dependencies, starting the transport and seeding data all belong in the infrastructure layer. import { Product } from "../domain/Product";
import { createApp } from "./createApp";

const catalogue = [
  new Product("widget", "Widget", 100),
  new Product("gadget", "Gadget", 50),
  new Product("gizmo", "Gizmo", 10),
];

const port = Number(process.env.PORT ?? 3000);
createApp(catalogue).listen(port, () => {

});
